name: Quote mở đầu (Hermann Weyl)
text: "The introduction of numbers as coordinates is an act of violence." - Hermann Weyl.

name: Vector là building block — 3 góc nhìn
text: The fundamental, root of it all building block for linear algebra is the vector. There are three distinct but related ideas about vectors: the physics student perspective, the computer science student perspective, and the mathematician's perspective.

name: Góc nhìn Vật lý: vector là mũi tên
text: The physics student perspective is that vectors are arrows pointing in space. What defines a given vector is its length and the direction it's pointing. As long as those two facts are the same, you can move it all around and it's still the same vector. Vectors in the flat plane are two-dimensional; those in broader space are three-dimensional.

name: Góc nhìn CS: vector là danh sách số có thứ tự
text: The computer science perspective is that vectors are ordered lists of numbers. For example, doing analytics about house prices where the features are square footage and price: you model each house with a pair of numbers. The order matters. You'd be modeling houses as two-dimensional vectors, where 'vector' is pretty much a fancy word for list, and what makes it two-dimensional is the length of that list is two.

name: Góc nhìn Toán học: tổng quát hóa
text: The mathematician seeks to generalize both views: a vector can be anything where there's a sensible notion of adding two vectors and multiplying a vector by a number. The details are rather abstract; it's healthy to ignore it until the last video of this series, favoring a more concrete setting in the interim.

name: Hình ảnh cần giữ trong đầu: mũi tên gốc tại origin
text: Vector addition and multiplication by numbers play an important role throughout linear algebra. Settle on a specific thought: whenever I introduce a new topic involving vectors, first think about an arrow, inside a coordinate system like the x-y plane, with its tail sitting at the origin.

name: Khác biệt với Vật lý: vector luôn gốc ở origin
text: This is a little different from the physics perspective, where vectors can sit anywhere. In linear algebra, it's almost always the case that your vector will be rooted at the origin. Once you understand a concept with arrows in space, we'll translate it to the list-of-numbers view by considering the coordinates of the vector.

name: Tọa độ vector trong 2D
text: Focusing on two dimensions: a horizontal x-axis and a vertical y-axis, intersecting at the origin. The coordinates of a vector is a pair of numbers giving instructions to get from the tail at the origin to its tip. The first number tells you how far to walk along x; the second how far parallel to y after that. Convention: write the pair vertically with square brackets, to distinguish vectors from points.

name: Tương ứng 1-1 + mở rộng sang 3D
text: Every pair of numbers gives one and only one vector, and every vector is associated with one and only one pair of numbers. In three dimensions, add a third z-axis perpendicular to both x and y. Each vector is associated with an ordered triplet of numbers — a one-to-one correspondence.

name: Phép cộng vector (tip-to-tail)
text: Back to vector addition and multiplication by numbers — every topic in linear algebra centers around these two operations. Two vectors, one pointing up-right, the other right-down. To add them, move the second so its tail sits at the tip of the first. Draw a new vector from the tail of the first to the tip of the second now — that new vector is their sum.
